description: HR-54 is the official RTO code for the Barara sub-division in the Ambala district of Haryana. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit services for the Barara region. It serves as a vital administrative hub for motor vehicle compliance in the eastern part of the Ambala district.
address: SDM Office Barara, District Ambala, Haryana
